meta_title: Alfian Andre Ramadhan — Fullstack Web Developer
meta_desc: Portfolio of Alfian Andre Ramadhan, a Jakarta-based fullstack web developer building production systems with Laravel, Vue, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js.

forte.note: I led Forte from the first commit: the Express API, the Next.js frontend, the scoring engine and the pipeline that deploys it.
forte.desc: People-assessment platform for hiring, team building and personal growth. Candidates take timed assessments and receive a scored profile; organizations manage members and results.
features: Architected the Express + Prisma API and the Next.js 16 frontend from the first commit
Resumable assessment sittings with offline answer sync and single-device takeover
Server-side scoring engine running on background jobs (BullMQ, outbox, dead-letter queue)
Bilingual CMS, organization management, OTP and Google sign-in, role-based access
Redis-backed rate limiting, refresh-token rotation, CI/CD to VPS via Bitbucket Pipelines

shots.home: Homepage: one assessment for hiring, team building and growth
shots.solutions: Forte Select: candidate report with scored competencies
shots.insight: Forte Insight: a personal InnerMap for individuals
shots.innermap: InnerMap sample report and how to read it
shots.science: The science page: how a result is built

medexpo.note: My part was the money and the seats: registration forms, hotel quotas, expired invoices, and USD payments reconciled to rupiah.
medexpo.desc: Next-generation medical event platform. Attendees buy full packages or single sessions; organizers manage participants, payments, badges and accommodation from one portal.
features: Configurable registration forms per registration type, with OTP confirmation and resumable drafts
Admin dashboard on live data, including per-night hotel room quotas
Hotel booking flows for personal and sponsored participants
Scheduler that releases seats from expired invoices, plus waitlist seat assignment
International bank transfers and IDR reconciliation for USD orders, covered by PHPUnit tests

shots.dashboard: Admin dashboard with live participant, hotel and abstract counts
shots.registration: Four-step participant registration with progress tracking
shots.sponsor: Sponsor registration for companies and their PIC
shots.login: Sign-in for participants, sponsors and admins

isicam.note: Three congress editions on one platform: tickets, abstracts with video, hotels and payments in two currencies.
isicam.desc: Registration and event platform for Indonesia's largest interventional cardiology congress, running three annual editions: ticketing, payments, abstracts, hotels and the scientific program.
features: Abstract submission with video upload to Cloudflare Stream
Multi-currency payments (IDR/USD) through Xendit, including sponsor group invoices
Hotel booking with add-ons and a room-quota dashboard
REST API for the companion mobile app (tickets, schedule, posters, payments)
Email delivery moved to ZeptoMail; security hardening across the app

shots.home: ISICAM 2026 homepage with the event countdown
shots.registration: Registration packages with IDR and USD pricing
shots.program: Full scientific program with filters and favourites
shots.abstracts: International case and research abstract competition
shots.venue: Venue and partner hotels for accommodation booking

wahanahonda.note: I've been the main maintainer since 2024: catalogue features, security hardening and the change requests that keep coming.
wahanahonda.desc: Official website and admin panel for Honda's main motorcycle dealer in Jakarta and Tangerang: catalogue, price lists, credit simulation, and test-ride and promo leads.
features: Catalogue features: EV specifications, variant images per price, model comparison
Moved the SMS OTP provider across all lead forms
Security hardening: input sanitization, signed resource IDs, rate limiting, security headers
Ongoing maintenance and client change requests since 2024

shots.home: Homepage with promos and quick tools
shots.catalogue: Motorcycle catalogue by category with OTR prices
shots.product: Product page with variants and specifications
shots.calculator: Credit simulation: down payment and monthly instalments

inahrsregistry.note: I set up the core of this one and built the membership flow: registration, approval, renewals and payments.
inahrsregistry.desc: Member portal and arrhythmia case registry for the Indonesian Heart Rhythm Society: doctors register and pay their membership, then submit ablation, CIED and AF cases for admin verification.
features: Set up the core from the internal boilerplate and the production build
Membership registration, admin approval and renewals, with Xendit payments and reminder emails
Middleware that limits the portal to members with an active membership
REST API covering auth, profile, registry, events and forum
Excel exports and reviewer notes for registry cases

shots.dashboard: Admin dashboard: members, pending approvals, active and expired
shots.register: Membership registration for specialists and allied professionals

inahrs.note: I built the member directory and moved the codebase from Laravel 8 to 11, one step at a time.
inahrs.desc: Public website and admin CMS of the Indonesian Heart Rhythm Society: member directory, meetings and events, training programs, guidelines and publications.
features: Built the member directory for doctors and allied health staff, with education, positions and work history
Upgraded the codebase step by step from Laravel 8 / PHP 7.3 to Laravel 11 / PHP 8.2
Led the 2026 homepage redesign and refreshed the detail pages for news, publications, training and fellowships
Public JSON API for guidelines, media and publications

shots.home: Redesigned homepage for the 2026 annual meeting

festivia.note: I upgraded Festivia from Laravel 5.5 to 10 step by step, and built its event builder and organizer payouts.
festivia.desc: Event marketplace for Indonesia: organizers list events and sell tickets and merchandise; attendees discover events by city, buy tickets and check in with QR codes.
features: Upgraded the codebase step by step from Laravel 5.5 / PHP 7.0 to Laravel 10 / PHP 8.1
Event builder with ticket types, seat maps, custom checkout fields and private events
Organizer payouts through Xendit sub-accounts, with withdrawal quotas and bank-account approval
Merchandise store with variants, promo codes and an approval flow
Venue check-in with QR scanning, re-registration and BIB numbers for races

shots.event: Event page with ticket sales and registration details

sinau.note: I built the checkout and the question bank with auto-graded tryouts, then upgraded it to Laravel 11.
sinau.desc: Online learning platform for medical students and doctors: UKMPPD tutoring, residency (PPDS) preparation, webinars, recorded lessons and tryouts.
features: End-to-end checkout with Midtrans, promo codes and per-product registration forms
Question bank with Excel import, tryouts and pre/post-tests with automatic grading
Time-limited and lifetime access to recorded lessons
Upgraded the codebase from Laravel 8 to Laravel 11 (PHP 8.2)
Admin reports and Excel exports for participants, transactions and test results

eria.note: I built the CMS and most public pages from the first commit, including a custom Tiptap editor and an interactive country map.
eria.desc: Website and CMS for ERIA's Regional Knowledge Centre for Marine Plastic Debris: publications, country regulations, events and a private-sector platform.
features: Built the admin CMS and most public pages from the first commit
Custom rich-text editor on Tiptap, plus a block-based flexible page builder
Interactive SVG country map and site-wide search across 11 content types
Private-sector platform: company registration, product submission, admin approval and email notifications

epic.desc: Housing management system for the EPIC group. Features include resident management, dues payment, complaint reporting, and guest tracking for residential areas.

stack_desc: The tools behind the projects above.
stack_laravel_desc: Most of my production work runs on Laravel: Inertia and Vue on the front, schedulers, payment integrations, and long-lived codebases I keep upgrading.
stack_js_desc: What I reach for on newer builds: Next.js on the front, an Express and Prisma API behind it, Redis and BullMQ for the background work.
stack_infra_desc: The parts around the code: CI/CD pipelines, process managers, and the payment and video services these systems depend on.
experience_education: STMIK Bani Saleh Bekasi · B.Sc. Information Systems · 2017–2021

Worked with designers, PMs and engineers on features, performance and production issues
